name: Step Function Resampling
definition: Resamples a step function defined by endpoints $tp$ and values $vp$ into new intervals $t$. If $use\_avg$ is False, returns the sum of the step function over each interval in $t$. If True, returns the average value weighted by interval width.
summary: Step Function Resampling aggregates piecewise-constant data into new intervals using exact inner and outer measures, preserving discontinuities rather than interpolating.
